name: session-hub
notes: ENV, one dependency: the hub's rows come from the sessions table in the live database, so the body text is machine-specific (which sessions exist, their ages, the branch tree). The assertions pin the FRAME SHAPE, not the body: the overlay is on, no other modal is, and the hub's own chrome renders (the title block ' Sessions [<filter>] ' at session_hub/render.rs:245 and, once rows land, the footer 's cycles filters · Esc closes' at :182). ENV, third and load-bearing: the headless runner paints a BOUNDED number of frames after the key events, and the session load lands on a spawn_blocking DB read — so the painted frame is the hub's interim state ('⏳ Loading sessions… · scanning local sessions and live subagents…' at :160-169). The asserts therefore pin strings present in BOTH states: the title block and the interim banner. The footer and rows are NOT asserted because they are a race, which is precisely the old session-branching exclusion's reason text rewritten as a scenario that can pass. The 120x40 /branch variant pins audit R1's replacement: /branch used to open the DELETED session_branching overlay and now opens THIS pane on the CurrentBranch filter, whose label 'this branch's tree' (session_hub/mod.rs:65) appears in the title block. VERIFY BY HAND for the body text against a machine with sessions; the shape assertions are the gate.
